Hon’ble S.K. Mishra, J.
Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Fartiyal, learned Additional C.S.C.
for the State.
Mr. Atul Bahuguna, learned counsel for 
Union of India.
Issue Rule Nisi.
Let the counter affidavit be filed by the 
respondents within four weeks from today, and
thereafter the rejoinder affidavit be filed by the 
petitioner within two weeks.
List this matter on 05.01.2023 connecting it 
with WPMS No. 1503 of 2022.
In the interregnum, it is directed that the
effect and operation of the impugned order shall
remain stayed. The parties are hereby directed to
maintain status quo qua the property in question
and shall not create any third party interest.
Stay Application (IA 1/2022) shall remain 
stayed till then.
